examples.translation: Why are almost all the police officers from the South [of Italy]? Because almost all government employees are from the South (independent studies found that it's more than ninety percent). And no wonder: those from the North have hundreds of different career paths to choose from in flourishing business. Southerners have only three paths: the government, the church, and the mafia. When we hear about the Italian police fighting the mafia, that means that one group of southerners is killing another group of southerners.
